summary: The musket (or the over-under) clubbed (user 2026-09-27: 'make it where we can turn muskets into clubs'; picked: middle mouse flips it, held by the barrel): the felling axe's attacks (AxeMelee via GatherTools.club) with the gun end for end in the hands, the butt as the head; the same clips and times (our own D, W, S; D mirrored for A; the stab (our own thrust); the parry sweep). Blunt: nothing is cut in to (cut.surfaces empty), a heavier thud on flesh and straw. Heavier than the axe: its attacks play at rate (0.88) of the axe's pace, and hit harder. guard: the two-handed guard between attacks (the D swing's first pose).

A.desc: left to right, two-handed (our own D mirrored: data/anim_author/axe_swings.json axe_a)

S.desc: the high block: the felling axe's (the haft, here the barrel and stock, held across above the forehead in both hands against W's chop: tools/anim_author/author_high_block.gd); no attack, no damage

STAB.desc: the stab: a one-handed underhand thrust of the butt straight ahead, held as the guard's right hand holds it (our own, keyed by hand: tools/anim_author/author_thrust.gd club_stab)

AD.desc: the parry: the felling axe's (our own two-handed sweep of the haft across the chest, knocking a thrust aside: tools/anim_author/author_parry.gd axe_parry), the gun held by the barrel as the axe by its haft

stamina._doc: the felling axe's, a little dearer for the heavier gun (AxeMelee.pay)

counters._doc: the only blocks (user 2026-09-27: "ad should only parry thrusts and [the] users should only block by counters and thats it"): the counter meets the blow head on; facing each other the side cuts are mirrored (user 2026-09-27: "i forget that it is mirrored for the other player ... if the user does the same attacks it cancel out ... besides the up down and down up"): D meets D and A meets A (each from its own right or left: the two edges come at each other), W is met by the high block (S: no attack, the haft held up across; two W go the same way and both land), the parry (AD) a stab and nothing else; in time it stops the blow, late or early it takes part of its damage (AxeMelee.block_power)
